$comment: The reference server's contract. Tests/harness/mcp_test.py compares tools/list with it.
serverInstructions: A reference MCP server for BridgeKitCore's tests. Call status to see whether it's on, echo to read text back, and write_note to make a change the user may have to approve.

$defs.$comment: Shared fragments, inlined into each tool's definition.

note.description: The note's text. Starting it with "slow" makes the write take 2 seconds.

tools.name: status
tools.title: Status
tools.description: Whether the reference server is on. Always visible.

tools.name: echo
tools.title: Echo
tools.description: Returns the text you send. delay_ms waits first, for timeout and cancellation tests.

tools.name: write_note
tools.title: Write a note
tools.description: Writes a note. Agents set up to ask need the user's approval first.
